Sometimes getting an appointment can be challenging, and I have in the past had telephone appointments cancelled and moved, but on the other hand I have in the past also been seen very quickly on a Friday afternoon when a condition suddenly developed.
I love the new online form to request an appointment. This works so well, allowing the surgery to record and review my symptoms. The surgery then contacts me to make necessary arrangements.
